_experiment.description: S1 neuron pruning, noise-Omega. Pair with e32: on structureless data the data-Omega vs noise-Omega gap should close (vs the +29pp gap on MNIST width-200). Same train section as e29 (seeded) so e29/e31/e32 share one dense net. omega_samples=1000 in both e31/e32 (data-Omega is capped at the 1000 loaded x_test rows), so only the Omega distribution differs.
literature: Dataset research: docs/dataset-research.md; data built by scripts/prep_dataset.py
